ns2:course.label: Gov & Pol of SE Asia
ns2:course.description: Provides a comparative analysis of the political development of the countries of Southeast Asia. Emphasis is placed on differing approaches to the governance and public policy formation, as well as economic, social, historical, and cultural influences on political development. Prerequisite: PS 240 or PS 241, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: PS 240 or PS 241, six hours of Political Science credit, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
